svg.aria-label: A Storyfeed feed growing: one plain row gains avatars, a photo and a key-value card; five volunteers joining fold into one grouped row; photos arrive live and regroup with a strip of thumbnails; the feed narrows to one person, then opens out to the whole feed as one more booking arrives.
